name: jpc-file-sorter
description: Jay Paul Company File Sorter: one decision per unique file, recorded to a spreadsheet. Never moves or deletes files.
whatsNew: Stages 4 and 5: first use that explains itself, accessibility, layout and scale
Short welcome card with an optional practice file that is never saved; the full tour is still under ? > Show me around
Honest 'suggestion' wording, a context bar showing scope and data source, a slim Open preview row, and the kept copy named in the copies card
Folder decisions list every file they will send, and every file left out with the reason, before you confirm
Review handles thousands of decisions: queues (To review, Conflicts, Reviewed, All), search, 50 per page, and a 'Finished reviewing' step; opening Review is about 7x faster
Laptop fit at 1280x720: one-row toolbar, one-line status bar, Decision panel stays on screen; contrast meets WCAG AA in light and dark
Dialogs are labelled, keep keyboard focus inside and return it on close; screen readers hear each decision and undo
SheetJS bundled with the app (no CDN), a content-security policy, and a bounded preview cache
